codeOnlyTokens.sticker-shadow: Sticker avatar's lift shadow, the same in both themes. Figma's Sticker avatar draws it as a fixed drop shadow; add the variable when effects bind to it.
codeOnlyTokens.particle-shadow: Reactions' flying emoji shadow, the same in both themes. Particles only exist in motion, so Figma has nothing to bind it to.

figmaOnlyProps.Avatar.type: Code picks image or initials from whether src loads; designers pick it by hand.
figmaOnlyProps.Checkbox.checked: Base UI's checked and indeterminate props, not a fibo prop.
figmaOnlyProps.Command menu.view: Which page is open is internal state in code.
figmaOnlyProps.Command menu.preview: Code shows the pane when an item has preview content; Figma toggles it.
figmaOnlyProps.Typing indicator.indicator: Code shows a person's indicator from data when they're the only one typing; designers pick it by hand.
figmaOnlyProps.Message.type: Code picks first, continuation, system or deleted from grouping rules and message data, not a prop.
figmaOnlyProps.Message divider.unread: Code draws the unread divider above the message named by unreadFrom.
figmaOnlyProps.Data table.selection: In code the selection is state, from value or defaultValue; Figma shows each state as a variant.
figmaOnlyProps.Data table.width: Code reads the container's width and switches at 32rem; Figma picks narrow by hand.
figmaOnlyProps.Floating nav item.type: Code makes an item text-only when it has no icon; designers pick it by hand.
figmaOnlyProps.Sticker avatar.shape: Code picks the shape from the image: a cut-out when its border is clear, round for a photo, initials with no image. Designers pick it by hand.
figmaOnlyProps.Radio group item.checked: Base UI checks the item whose value matches the group's value; designers pick it by hand.
figmaOnlyProps.Switch.checked: Base UI's checked and defaultChecked props, not a fibo prop.
figmaOnlyProps.Slider.thumbs: Code draws one thumb per value passed; Figma picks one or two by hand.
figmaOnlyProps.Pagination.position: Code disables Previous and Next from page and pageCount; designers pick first, middle or last by hand.
figmaOnlyProps.Menu checkbox item.checked: Base UI's checked and defaultChecked props, not a fibo prop.
figmaOnlyProps.Menu radio item.checked: Base UI checks the item whose value matches the radio group's value; designers pick it by hand.
figmaOnlyProps.Toast.type: The type is passed to toast.add() as data, not as a component prop.
figmaOnlyProps.Filter menu.view: Which view shows is internal state in code.
figmaOnlyProps.Filter menu row.kind: Code renders a field or an option row from its data; designers pick it by hand.
figmaOnlyProps.Filter menu row.checked: Code checks options and counts a field from the value; designers pick it by hand.
figmaOnlyProps.Pixel snail.size: size is keyof typeof SCALE in code, which the check cannot read; its options are sm, default and lg, as here.

codeOnlyProps.reactions.position: Which viewport corner the floating bar pins to; Figma shows the bar on its own.

codeOnlyComponents.spinner: Deprecated, and removed at the next minor release, so it gets no Figma component.
